critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1043 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, payments, search) before it grows further.

PATCH /admin/users only allows role in (user, intermediary); once an intermediary is demoted, promoting back to intermediary via admin API leaves rui_number null with no way to reassign RUI. Consider allowing admin to set rui_number when promoting, or expose a dedicated endpoint.

Admin drawer treats any role==='admin' as MASTER for UI protection. Since spec is 'single master admin' this is fine today, but if additional admins are ever added, backend still only protects the MASTER_ADMIN_EMAIL. Frontend and backend rules should stay aligned.
